request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:GUARD

layers.text: Change three things only. The big biscuit shield becomes a big round liquorice wheel: a black coil #23192b, wound in a spiral with a bright pink centre #ff8fc0. A black liquorice band runs round the middle of its body like a belt, and its feet are black. The pink frosting on its top becomes lemon yellow #ffe04a. Do not redraw anything else: keep the white marshmallow body, the face, the cheeks, the arms, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
